title: Agent Identity attestation status claims (agent-rp-attestation-status+jwt)
description: Contract I status JWS claims returned by the broker's `attestation_status_uri` (agent-identity-v1.md §16). Header: {alg: EdDSA, typ: agent-rp-attestation-status+jwt, kid}. `sub` is the queried attestation `jti`; `exp - iat` MUST equal exactly 300 seconds; `status_changed_at` MUST NOT be after `iat` (cross-field rules enforced by Zod and the validator). The endpoint's plaintext `attestation_jti` field is advisory: clients MUST verify this JWS and use `sub`. Caching is bounded to 300 seconds.

iss.description: Broker issuer origin. MUST equal the metadata `issuer`.

jti.description: Unique status-response id (UUIDv4). Not the attestation id.

sub.description: The queried attestation `jti`. Clients MUST check it equals the `attestation_jti` they asked about.

status_changed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. MUST NOT be after `iat`.
